art_direction: 伏黑惠穿深蓝针织衫坐在雨窗边，安静看着窗外蓝灰色城市。
composition_variation: Create a quiet painterly anime portrait of Megumi Fushiguro seated beside a tall rainy window. Preserve his distinctive spiky black hair, dark green eyes, and reserved youthful expression. Dress him in a fully covering navy knit sweater, charcoal trousers, and simple sneakers. His forearms rest comfortably on the windowsill while he looks outside in gentle profile; both hands remain relaxed. Use blue-gray rain streaks, silver city reflections, one muted green houseplant near the bottom, and soft diffused daylight above. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
